blurb: Guests take a one hour guided horseback riding tour on a well groomed trail featuring wildlife, wild flowers, fresh running water, and a 200 ft. tunnel. The trail passes by Boot Hill Cemetery and a western town called Tombstone with a sheriff and jailhouse. The ride includes crossing a bridge to Lost Canyon and seeing a waterfall before returning to the stables, where guests can visit a free petting zoo.
